verses.text_urhobo: Rẹ imu nana vwọ wan nu ota rẹ Ọrovwohwo de bru Ebram rhe vwẹ evwerhẹ, Wọ djẹ oshọ-ọ, Ebram, mẹvwẹ ekpọfia wẹn, osa wẹn cha rho gangan.
verses.text_romanized: re imu nana vwo wan nu ota re orovwohwo de bru ebram rhe vwe evwerhe wo dje osho o ebram mevwe ekpofia wen osa wen cha rho gangan

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo Ebram da ta, E Ọrovwohwo Ọghẹnẹ, kidie wọ kẹ vwẹ, fikiridie mi ji vwo ọmọ-ọ, ohwo rọ re uku rẹ uwevwi mẹ kẹ Ẹliẹza ri Damaskọs?
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo ebram da ta e orovwohwo oghene kidie wo ke vwe fikiridie mi ji vwo omo o ohwo ro re uku re uwevwi me ke elieza ri damaskos

verses.text_urhobo: Ebram da ta, Nighe, wọ je kẹ vwẹ ọmọ-ọ, ọviẹn re vwiẹ vwẹ uwevwi mẹ kọye cha re uku mẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ebram da ta nighe wo je ke vwe omo o ovien re vwie vwe uwevwi me koye cha re uku me

verses.text_urhobo: Nighe, ota rẹ Ọrovwohwo de bro rhe, Ohwo nana cha dia ọriuku wẹ-ẹn, ọmọ rẹ obọ wẹn re cha dia ọriuku wẹn.
verses.text_romanized: nighe ota re orovwohwo de bro rhe ohwo nana cha dia oriuku we en omo re obo wen re cha dia oriuku wen

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da reyọ rhe otafe ọ da ta, Gbe ni enu na, ru wo keri isio na, su wo se kere ayen. Etiyin ọ da ta kẹ, Ọtiọye uvwiẹ wẹn cha dia.
verses.text_romanized: o da reyo rhe otafe o da ta gbe ni enu na ru wo keri isio na su wo se kere ayen etiyin o da ta ke otioye uvwie wen cha dia

verses.text_urhobo: O de se Ọrovwohwo gbuyota, o de kere vwọ kẹ nẹ ọvwata o ruẹ.
verses.text_romanized: o de se orovwohwo gbuyota o de kere vwo ke ne ovwata o rue

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da ta kẹ, Mẹvwẹ Ọrovwohwo rọ reyọ owẹ ni Ur ri Kaldia rhe, ro kẹ wẹ otọ nana vwọ re uku.
verses.text_romanized: o da ta ke mevwe orovwohwo ro reyo owe ni ur ri kaldia rhe ro ke we oto nana vwo re uku

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo ọ da ta, E Ọrovwohwo Ọghẹnẹ, komavọ mi ru riẹn nẹ mi che vwo otọ na?
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo o da ta e orovwohwo oghene komavo mi ru rien ne mi che vwo oto na

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da ta kẹ, Reyọ upene rẹ erhuẹn rẹ ikperha, ẹvwe aye rẹ ikperha, egbo rẹ ikperha, inekuku, kugbe eme erurẹ.
verses.text_romanized: o da ta ke reyo upene re erhuen re ikperha evwe aye re ikperha egbo re ikperha inekuku kugbe eme erure

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da ghwe aye ejobi vwo rhe, ọ da bẹrẹ ayen ivivẹ, o de mu ayen ohwohwo kpahe ohwo, ẹkẹvuọvo ephra na ọ gbe bẹrẹ ayen ivivẹ-ẹ.
verses.text_romanized: o da ghwe aye ejobi vwo rhe o da bere ayen ivive o de mu ayen ohwohwo kpahe ohwo ekevuovo ephra na o gbe bere ayen ivive e

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ ekala vwọ rhan mu ayen re cha vwọ sohrọ ayen, Ebram da djẹ ayen yanran.
verses.text_romanized: oke re ekala vwo rhan mu ayen re cha vwo sohro ayen ebram da dje ayen yanran

verses.text_urhobo: Rẹ ọnre vwo kpotọ re, ovwerhẹ rode de mu Ebram, o vwo ni, oshọ rode vẹ egho de rhi rhuro.
verses.text_romanized: re onre vwo kpoto re ovwerhe rode de mu ebram o vwo ni osho rode ve egho de rhi rhuro

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Ọrovwohwo da ta kẹ Ebram, Riẹn gbagba nẹ uvwiẹ wẹn che suosuo vwẹ otọ rẹ ihwo efa, ke dia eviẹn vwẹ oboyi, ke shenyẹ ayen ikpe uri ivẹ,
verses.text_romanized: etiyin orovwohwo da ta ke ebram rien gbagba ne uvwie wen che suosuo vwe oto re ihwo efa ke dia evien vwe oboyi ke shenye ayen ikpe uri ive

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo ke Me cha vwẹ ẹgborho re ayen na vwo guẹdjọ, tavwe ayen ki norhe vẹ eyenre buebu.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo ke me cha vwe egborho re ayen na vwo guedjo tavwe ayen ki norhe ve eyenre buebu

verses.text_urhobo: Vwọ kẹ oma wẹn, ku wo rhivwi bru esẹ wẹn ra egberhẹnẹdẹ, ke shi we vẹ uyovwi esha hẹrẹhẹrẹ.
verses.text_romanized: vwo ke oma wen ku wo rhivwi bru ese wen ra egberhenede ke shi we ve uyovwi esha herehere

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ orua rẹ ẹne kẹsiẹye aye ki che rhivwi rhe, fikiridie orukuruku rẹ ihwo rẹ Amọr je gba-a.
verses.text_romanized: vwe orua re ene kesieye aye ki che rhivwi rhe fikiridie orukuruku re ihwo re amor je gba a

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ ọnre vwo she nu rẹ ebri vwo mu re, nighe, ubrochẹ vẹ erhanre ro bru ivwirhi vẹ ukpe rọ la da va nẹ uvwre rẹ ibro rẹ eranvwe na rhe.
verses.text_romanized: oke re onre vwo she nu re ebri vwo mu re nighe ubroche ve erhanre ro bru ivwirhi ve ukpe ro la da va ne uvwre re ibro re eranvwe na rhe

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ ẹdẹ yena Ọrovwohwo vẹ Ebram da re ọphọ tanẹ, Uvwiẹ wẹn Me vwẹ otọ nana kẹ, nẹ urhie rẹ Ijipt re te urhie rode na, urhie ri Yufretis.
verses.text_romanized: vwe ede yena orovwohwo ve ebram da re opho tane uvwie wen me vwe oto nana ke ne urhie re ijipt re te urhie rode na urhie ri yufretis

verses.text_urhobo: Otọ rẹ ihwo ri Ken, ihwo ri Keniz, ihwo ri Kadmon,
verses.text_romanized: oto re ihwo ri ken ihwo ri keniz ihwo ri kadmon

verses.text_urhobo: ihwo ri Hẹt, ihwo ri Pẹriz, ihwo ri Rifrem,
verses.text_romanized: ihwo ri het ihwo ri periz ihwo ri rifrem

verses.text_urhobo: ihwo rẹ Amọn, ihwo ri Kenan, ihwo ri Girgash kugbe ihwo ri Jebu.
verses.text_romanized: ihwo re amon ihwo ri kenan ihwo ri girgash kugbe ihwo ri jebu
